Colorful tool icons
Each tool gets its own accent color here and in the toolbox. Open a tool to change the color of that one icon.

Each tool gets an accent colour of its own, here and in the toolbox, which makes a tool easier to find. Open a tool to change the colour of that one icon. With this off, every tool uses the theme\'s one colour. This setting is on by default.
Gradient tool colors
Paint each tool with two colors, from the top left to the bottom right

Off, a tool is one flat color. On, every tool becomes a gradient that runs from its color at the top left to a second color at the bottom right. The second color is worked out from the first, so you need not pick one. To choose both, open the tool and set the start color and the end color.

Tools are on the keyboard toolbar and in the toolbox. The grid button on the toolbar opens the toolbox. The switch turns a tool on. Press a row to open the settings of that tool. The ⚙ marks the tools that have options of their own.
Reset custom colors
Built-in file manager
Tools pick files inside the keyboard. Off, they open Android\'s picker
When a tool needs a file, you pick it in a file list inside the keyboard. With this off, the tool opens Android\'s own file picker. This setting is on by default.
Close floating boxes on a tap outside
A tap anywhere else on the screen closes a tool\'s floating box
A tap anywhere outside a tool\'s floating box closes the box. With this off, a box stays open until you close it with its button. This setting is off by default.
Floating box gestures instead of buttons

Hides the buttons of a floating box and uses throws in their place. Throw the box up to close it, down to move it into the keyboard, or to a side to tuck it away. A slow drag on its title bar still moves it. The grip in its bottom right corner resizes it, and so does pinching the box with two fingers. This setting is off by default.
Hold a floating box to move it
Hold a finger still anywhere on a floating box, then drag it, even over a list or a slider

Hold a finger still anywhere on a floating box, then drag to move the box. It works even on a list or a slider inside the box. With this off, you drag the box by its top bar. This setting is off by default.
Swipe up on a tool to float it
A swipe up on a toolbar tool that can float opens it in its floating box

Swipe up on a tool on the toolbar that can float, such as the calculator or the clipboard, and it rises out of the keyboard into its floating box over the app. While it is out there, its toolbar button is greyed a little. Tap that button to bring the tool back into the keyboard. Holding a tool still works as it did. This setting is on by default.
Floating tool animation
How long a tool takes to rise into its floating box and to drop back into the keyboard

How long the animation lasts when a tool swiped up from the toolbar rises into its floating box, and when a tap on its button brings it back. Set it to Off to open and close the box at once. Reduce motion turns the animation off too. The default is 240 ms.

Each tool keeps its own height
Dragging the bar on top of a tool sets that tool\'s height only

Normally, tools of one kind share a height: making the search panel taller makes the emoji panel taller too. With this on, each tool and panel remembers the height you drag its bar to. A tool you have not resized yet opens at the shared height. This setting is off by default.
Reset tool heights
Hides a floating box\'s buttons: throw it up to close it, down to move it into the keyboard, or into a side to tuck it
Hide the title bar
A floating box shows only its tool, with no bar along the top

Takes the title bar off a floating box, so the tool fills it. Move the box by dragging any part of the tool that doesn\'t scroll, with two fingers, or by holding it if Hold a floating box to move it is on. Throws still close, tuck or dock it. The see-through button and the double tap that rolls the box up go with the bar. This setting is off by default.
Hide the outline and grip
No line round a floating box and no resize grip in its corner
Takes the thin outline off a floating box, and the small grip in its corner that resizes it. Pinch the box with two fingers to resize it instead. This setting is off by default.
Split the Panels group
Show Writing and Connect and media as two groups
Shows the Panels group of the Tools screen as two smaller groups, Writing and Connect and media. The tools are the same. This setting is off by default.

Plugins

An installed plugin can be a tool like the ones above, with its own icon: in the toolbox, where it drags into place, goes into folders and turns up in the search, or pinned to the toolbar. Switch one on to put it in the toolbox; tap it for its page, which can pin it too.
